title: Copy-editing component in the article editor
description:
Show findings on the draft in the article editor.

## Scope
- Replace the body `<Textarea>` in `components/newsroom-article-editor.tsx` with CodeMirror 6 (`@codemirror/view` decorations + `StateField`; Markdown language mode, Markus directive highlighting) — overlapping marks, severity styling, offsets remapped through edits.
- Findings panel grouped by policy; click to scroll; status violation vs. review.
- Select any sentence or paragraph and ask for rewrite options (optional note), even where nothing was flagged.
- Actions: dismiss (reason), request suggestions (Luna via `suggestRewrites`), accept a suggestion as a targeted patch.
- Debounced incremental check after edits; stale-result handling by content hash.
- Precedent: `components/reference-relevance-review.tsx`.
